doc: Signed zeros through arctan2 (IEEE atan2, as C99): y = +0.0 on the negative x axis gives lon = +pi and y = -0.0 gives -pi (both are the antimeridian: sample_equirect returns the same value for either); at a pole (x = y = 0) the longitude is 0, +pi, -0 or -pi by the signs of the zeros, which has no geometric meaning. Tagged degenerate: a port that does not reproduce signed-zero atan2 (WGSL does not guarantee it) may skip this case, as long as it treats both antimeridian cases alike. lat is exact.
